name: job-post-audit-chat
description: Audit a pasted job description for fit, keywords, scam signals, and next steps. Emits job-post-audit-report. Not legal advice.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a pasted job description, company name, role context, background, or careers URL.

inputs.name: job-description
inputs.description: Full job posting text to analyze.

inputs.name: candidate-background
inputs.description: Pasted resume excerpt or summary of experience for fit matrix.

inputs.name: careers-page-url
inputs.description: Optional public HTTPS careers URL to verify listing (best-effort).

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Answers from a prior clarification loop.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: job-post-audit-report
outputs.description: Structured job post audit; empty when the job description is missing.
